mapper.select: SELECT * FROM security_holding ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO security_holding (account_id, symbol, name, currency_code, quantity, average_price, current_price, value_native, value_krw, exchange_rate) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{symbol}, #{name}, #{currencyCode}, #{quantity}, #{averagePrice}, #{currentPrice}, #{valueNative}, #{valueKrw}, #{exchangeRate})
mapper.update: UPDATE security_holding SET account_id=#{accountId}, symbol=#{symbol}, name=#{name}, currency_code=#{currencyCode}, quantity=#{quantity}, average_price=#{averagePrice}, current_price=#{currentPrice}, value_native=#{valueNative}, value_krw=#{valueKrw}, exchange_rate=#{exchangeRate}, updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{id}
